Presidents Ilham Aliyev and Recep Tayyip Erdoğan posed for photographs in front of Shusha Fortress
articles.summary: President of the Republic of Azerbaijan Ilham Aliyev and President of the Republic of Türkiye Recep Tayyip Erdoğan posed for photographs in front of Shusha Fortress on November 8.
